item.title: You be the judge: should my girlfriend stop annotating her books?
item.summary: Julie makes notes in the margin as she’s reading, but Charlie says she’s ruining books he may want to read. Should they get on the same page? You decide • Find out how to get a disagreement settled or become a juror It breaks my immersion in the stories – like when someone says ‘This next bit is so good’ Continue reading...
